fixed_data_comparison.limit: The fixed-data comparator is bounded to extracted profile fields and does not certify complete sheet behavior or playable army legality.

options: Replace Master-crafted Bolter and Heavy Bolt Pistol with Neo-volkite Pistol.
Replace Master-crafted Bolter and Heavy Bolt Pistol with Plasma Pistol.
Replace Master-crafted Bolter with Relic Shield; the Master-crafted Power Weapon cannot be replaced in this package.
Replace Master-crafted Power Weapon with Power Fist.

scope: Exact one-model, 90-point, 40 mm Captain profile, source characteristics, invulnerable save, keywords and default equipment; current local construction admits one to three copies and rejects four.

The public preparation flow supports the seven legal packages: default, Neo-volkite or Plasma Pistol each with Master-crafted Power Weapon or Power Fist, plus Relic Shield with Master-crafted Power Weapon. Plasma standard/supercharge profiles and all equipped weapon routes pass Equipment and AttackPlan checks.

Relic Shield adds one wound and restores the correct maximum/current wounds. The source does not allow replacing Master-crafted Power Weapon when the Relic Shield is selected; the public choices and command handler reject Shield plus Power Fist in either direction.

Both players materialize from the consolidated current Space Marines catalog. The runtime Leader links match all nine common-book targets; the shared relation suite checks all 153 Leader/Support links, while available materialization fixtures cover the supported targets.

Strategic Acumen is owner-checked, selects an active Combat Doctrine in the Command phase, is limited to once in that phase, persists through the opponent Command phase and expires at the next own Command phase.
Finest Hour is offered through the public Fight-phase choice, adds three melee attacks and Devastating Wounds for the phase, and can be used once per battle.
Transhuman Strategist grants one CP once per battle round when the Captain is the Warlord; Warlord selection is included in the source-bounded local checks.
